# Benchmark catalog

<!-- Generated by `scripts/bench docs` from bench.toml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every row is one Go-vs-Rust comparison. *Rounds* are independent process
launches (Go and Rust interleaved in a seeded random order within each round);
*timing* is the per-process protocol described in METHODOLOGY.md.
Commands show the `standard` profile; `quick`/`full` change sizes, rounds and timing.

| Profile | Rounds | Per-process timing |
|---|---|---|
| `quick` | 3 | warmup ≥1 iters & ≥100 ms; measure ≥3 iters & ≥300 ms |
| `standard` | 10 | warmup ≥2 iters & ≥500 ms; measure ≥5 iters & ≥1000 ms |
| `full` | 20 | warmup ≥3 iters & ≥1000 ms; measure ≥10 iters & ≥2000 ms |

## Harness self-test

### `selftest.spin`

Harness self-test: a deterministic integer mixing loop.

- **Implementations:** go: `spin` in `go/selftest/`, rust: `spin` in `rust/selftest/`
- **Track:** `baseline`
- **CPU pinning:** `single` → cores `3`
- **Sizes:** `1M` (quick/standard/full)
- **quick:** 3 rounds; warmup ≥1 iters & ≥100 ms; measure ≥3 iters & ≥300 ms
- **standard:** 10 rounds; warmup ≥2 iters & ≥500 ms; measure ≥5 iters & ≥1000 ms
- **full:** 20 rounds; warmup ≥3 iters & ≥1000 ms; measure ≥10 iters & ≥2000 ms
- **Command (go):** `taskset -c 3 bin/go/selftest run spin --param n=1000000 --warmup-iters 2 --warmup-min-ms 500 --iters 5 --min-ms 1000`
- **Command (rust):** `taskset -c 3 bin/rust/selftest run spin --param n=1000000 --warmup-iters 2 --warmup-min-ms 500 --iters 5 --min-ms 1000`

### `selftest.opspin`

Harness self-test for per-operation timing (histograms).

- **Implementations:** go: `opspin` in `go/selftest/`, rust: `opspin` in `rust/selftest/`
- **Track:** `baseline`
- **CPU pinning:** `single` → cores `3`
- **Sizes:** `1k` (quick/standard/full)
- **quick:** 3 rounds; warmup ≥1 iters & ≥100 ms; measure ≥3 iters & ≥300 ms
- **standard:** 10 rounds; warmup ≥2 iters & ≥500 ms; measure ≥5 iters & ≥1000 ms
- **full:** 20 rounds; warmup ≥3 iters & ≥1000 ms; measure ≥10 iters & ≥2000 ms
- **Command (go):** `taskset -c 3 bin/go/selftest run opspin --param n=1000 --warmup-iters 2 --warmup-min-ms 500 --iters 5 --min-ms 1000`
- **Command (rust):** `taskset -c 3 bin/rust/selftest run opspin --param n=1000 --warmup-iters 2 --warmup-min-ms 500 --iters 5 --min-ms 1000`
